# MEOK AI Labs — Sovereign AI Platform

> MEOK AI Labs builds sovereign AI infrastructure: personal AI companions (meok.ai), 
> EU AI Act compliance automation (safetyof.ai), and 218 MCP servers for AI governance.

## Products
- [MEOK AI Companion](https://meok.ai): Personal AI that learns you. Sovereign, private, caring.
- [SafetyOf.AI](https://safetyof.ai): EU AI Act compliance platform. 48-hour audits, continuous monitoring.
- [MCP Marketplace](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG): 218 open-source compliance MCP servers.

## Compliance MCP Servers
- [EU AI Act](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/eu-ai-act-compliance-mcp): Risk classification, 42-point audit, Annex IV docs
- [GDPR](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/gdpr-compliance-ai-mcp): DPIA, data subject rights, breach notification
- [ISO 27001](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/iso-27001-ai-mcp): ISMS audit, risk assessment, SoA generation
- [ISO 42001](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/iso-42001-ai-mcp): AI management system, Annex A controls
- [NIS2](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/nis2-compliance-mcp): Entity classification, Article 21 measures
- [DORA](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/dora-compliance-mcp): Digital operational resilience
- [Care Membrane](https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG/care-membrane-mcp): AI safety via care ethics validation

## Install All Compliance MCPs
```bash
npx meok-setup --pack governance
```

- SafetyOf.AI Enterprise: £499/mo
- EU AI Act Audit: £5,000 one-time
- MCP servers: Free and open source (MIT)
